title: Agent App operations manifest (opsVersion 1)
description: The Agent interface of a Agent App app (spec REQUIREMENTS §8). Discoverable at GET /api/_ops.

label.description: Short name for people, shown on buttons and in forms (e.g. "Add expense"). Defaults to one derived from the op name.

system.description: True for tooling-maintained built-ins (health, ops.list, …). Agents never edit system entries.

destructive.description: Marks ops that delete/overwrite data; hosts show confirmation and AGENT-ACCESS may require per-call consent (AC-E3).

readOnly.description: True when the op changes nothing. Defaults to true for GET and crud list, false otherwise. Views may only read from readOnly ops.

confirm.description: The question a host asks before running a destructive op (e.g. "Delete this expense for good?").

returns.description: Shape of a successful result, so hosts can lay it out: one record, a list of records, a summary object, a series of points, a job, or nothing.

label.description: Field label for people. Defaults to the param name.

format.description: How a host edits and shows a string param: date (YYYY-MM-DD), datetime, money, percent, multiline text, secret (masked, never echoed), json (validated JSON text), or ref:<collection> (a record id picked from that collection).

oneOf.description: Calls a pb_hooks route. Params become the JSON body (POST/PUT/PATCH) or query string (GET/DELETE).

filter.description: Fixed PB filter applied to list/update/delete.

oneOf.description: Declarative pointer to parameterized collection CRUD — no hook needed.
Starts long-running work; the route MUST return {"jobId": …} and status MUST be pollable at GET /api/_jobs/{jobId}.
